concrete_capability_transition: CLI run/resume changes from objective-derived run identity and unscoped global continuation to unique per-invocation run identity plus Rust-runtime-owned scoped resume selection for the latest CLI-created objective.

strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: Ensures repeated brownie run invocations are independent executions and brownie resume continues the latest CLI-created objective rather than an unrelated globally sorted task.
Preserves runtime-owned continuation selection, freshness validation, replay lookup, and execution while adding an explicit scoped continuation contract.
Uses existing persisted journey-start checkpoint evidence through the store API so resume provenance is runtime-owned and replay-safe without CLI ledger inspection.

answers.strategic_capabilities: Advances headless_autonomous_development, agent_loop, and context_management by making CLI-created objective identity unique per invocation and making resume target selection scoped by runtime-owned journey evidence.
answers.new_capability: A user can run the same objective text multiple times and receive distinct runtime session/drive/journey identities; brownie resume asks the runtime to continue only the latest CLI-created objective scope.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: CLI-4/CLI-5 made run and resume executable, but run identity was derived from objective text and resume passed only global progress freshness, letting runtime select the first globally eligible task.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: Repeated objective text can collide with prior execution state, and resume can continue older or unrelated work, blocking trustworthy CLI restart/recovery behavior before CLI-6 and CLI-10.
answers.non_duplicative: This is not another resume wrapper: it changes the run identity contract and runtime continuation selection boundary, which CLI-1 through CLI-5 did not cover.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. The phase extends the existing headless.continue_once params with an optional continuation_scope and keeps brownie run on existing headless.run.drive.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. It adds no report, readiness, digest, history, verdict, or inspection surface; tests assert concrete execution and selection behavior.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: Runtime behavior changes when continuation_scope is supplied: eligible task selection is filtered by persisted journey-start evidence and fails closed instead of falling back to global task sorting.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: Headless CLI callers can safely repeat objectives and resume after lost responses while the Rust runtime remains the authority for freshness, replay, provenance, and task execution.
answers.milestone_progress: Closes a blocking correctness debt found between CLI-5 and CLI-6, making later progress UX and restart/recovery golden journey validation meaningful.

guard_engine_change_review.review_intent: CLI-5.1 updates the deterministic current phase manifest. Review must confirm the PR changes executable run identity and runtime-owned scoped resume behavior without weakening the phase-value guard or adding wrapper-only surfaces.

exit_criteria: Two brownie run invocations with identical objective text send distinct session_id, drive_id, and journey_id values to headless.run.drive.
brownie run still sends the original objective text only as journey_admission.task_start.goal and does not make develop primary.

brownie resume calls task.list before continuation and sends headless.continue_once with fresh expected_progress_fingerprint, expected_aggregate_sequence, deterministic cli.resume continuation_id, max_steps 1, and continuation_scope session_id_prefix cli.run. with latest_matching_session true.
Runtime headless.continue_once filters scoped normal continuation candidates using persisted journey-start checkpoints and task descendants under the selected CLI-created journey.
Runtime scoped continuation selects the latest matching CLI journey instead of older CLI or unrelated global tasks.
Runtime scoped continuation returns no_eligible_task when the latest matching CLI journey has no runnable candidate and does not fallback to older/global tasks.
Scope validation fails closed for missing selectors, invalid selector characters, ambiguous non-latest matches, and unsupported target/scope combinations.
Existing unscoped headless.continue_once behavior remains compatible for existing callers.

accepted_capability: CLI run invocation identity is unique per run even when objective text repeats.
CLI resume delegates scoped latest CLI objective continuation to the Rust runtime through persisted journey evidence.
behavior_evidence: Tests cover distinct same-objective invocation identities.
Tests cover scoped resume request shape.
Tests cover runtime latest CLI journey selection and no-fallback terminal latest behavior.
safety_boundary: No Core Runtime terminal campaign state is reopened or mutated.
No new runtime JSON-RPC method is added.
The CLI does not inspect raw ledger files, sort candidates, choose task ids, or duplicate continuation policy.
The runtime uses existing store checkpoint evidence and existing freshness/replay boundaries.
CLI output continues excluding raw prompts, provider responses, ledger payloads, file content, stdout/stderr payloads, commands, environment values, absolute paths, canonical paths, and secrets.
non_goals: No stable full public JSON projection overhaul, installation/package release, arbitrary-repository golden journey, or restart/recovery golden journey closure.
No Mode Pack, Product DoD, provider, permission, workspace mutation, or fail-closed semantic redesign.
No generic RPC passthrough, report, readiness, history, digest, verdict, preview, or summary surface.
rejected_alternatives: Rejected storing CLI-owned run registries because persisted journey evidence already belongs to the Rust runtime.
Rejected CLI-side task sorting or selection because resume target selection is runtime authority.
Rejected deriving invocation identity from objective text because it aliases distinct executions.
Rejected a new resume RPC because an optional scope on headless.continue_once preserves the existing execution authority surface.
technical_debt: CLI-6 must improve progress and next-action UX after continuation correctness is fixed.
CLI-7 must complete stable bounded public JSON projections and deterministic exit-code semantics.
CLI-10 must validate the full restart/recovery golden journey using scoped resume.
next_capability_rationale: After CLI-5.1 lands, proceed to CLI-6 Progress and Next Action UX rather than adding another resume wrapper.
